baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural subject al-abrar, the verb yashrabun, the content-bearing ka's, mizajuha, and kafuran.
baseline_models.mechanism: A righteous cohort physically imbibes the contents of a cup whose liquid has been mixed with aromatic camphor; kana predicates an already constituted mixture.

activation_trace.role: Expansive righteousness identifies the human recipients of the drink.
Literal imbibing supplies the bodily act at the center of the scene.
The cup together with its contents makes the vessel stand for the served liquid.
Temporal predication presents the mixture as an established property of the cup.
Mixing one substance with another supplies the beverage's composition.
Aromatic kafur supplies the named sensory constituent.

changed_reading.before: The good are simply said to drink.
changed_reading.after: The focus ayah stages a materially specified reward: righteous people imbibe a cup whose contents have an established aromatic blend.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Yashrabun can evoke an allotted water-share, while mizaj can name bodily constitution as well as mixture.
baseline_models.mechanism: The cup can be heard as an apportioned draught whose blend is fitted to, or acts upon, the drinkers' constitution rather than as flavor alone.

activation_trace.role: The righteous plural provides the group to whom a beneficial portion is assigned.
An allotted share of water recasts drinking as reception of a measured portion.
Bodily temperament lets the liquid mixture resonate with the drinker's own composition.
Aromatic kafur gives the constitutional draught a concrete ingredient.

changed_reading.before: The mixture is an optional flavor added to a generic drink.
changed_reading.after: The drink may be a specifically allotted, constitutionally fitted draught whose composition matters to its recipients.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural al-abrar yashrabun combines a kindness-oriented branch of birr with a branch of shurb naming co-drinkers.
baseline_models.mechanism: The grammar and branch images permit a social table: dutifully connected people drink as a company, and the filled cup marks fellowship rather than isolated consumption.

activation_trace.role: Dutiful kindness against estrangement gives the group a relational character.
Drinkers and co-drinkers turn the plural verb into a scene of shared participation.
The cup with its contents supplies the common table's concrete vessel.

changed_reading.before: Each righteous individual privately consumes a reward.
changed_reading.after: The plural scene can foreground a reconciled company sharing in a served drink.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human begins as a mixed fluid, is held together in a bodily frame, and remains subject to changed form; against that sequence, mizaj in the cup can signify a counter-mixture that reconstitutes the tested creature.

activation_trace.role: Bodily temperament anchors the reward mixture back to human constitution.
Clear fluid ranging from drop onward supplies the material origin that precedes the later draught.
The mixed seminal drop establishes the human as a compound before the focus cup is introduced.
Cohesion of bodily form and joints makes constitution a held-together structure.
Changing a thing's form keeps bodily recomposition materially live at the surah's close.

structural_cues: 76:2 places a mixed drop before testing, while 76:28 returns to the created body's cohesion and replaceability.
The focus ayah lies between those two descriptions and makes another mixture the object of ingestion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mixed origin, bodily cohesion, possible formal change, and the constitutional branch of mizaj; I infer that the reward-draught reconstitutes the person, while the live alternative is a purely culinary echo with no physiological arrow.

changed_reading.before: The camphor blend only pleases an already completed recipient.
changed_reading.after: The blend can answer the creature's first mixture with a second, restorative composition: mixed origin becomes consciously imbibed reconstitution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first opposes gratitude to kafur as covering a favor, then immediately turns the same root-shape into aromatic kafur inside the righteous drink, and later calls their striving mashkur; a negative covering is rhetorically converted into a fragrant constituent of acknowledged gift.

activation_trace.role: Aromatic kafur anchors the positive, sensory use in the focus cup.
The covering image makes the shared root's semantic pressure visible without replacing the aromatic sense.
Acknowledging favor supplies the positive pole immediately before the focus.
The effort being thanked closes the gratitude arc around the aromatic reward.
Covering over a favor supplies the negative kafur pole that the next positive occurrence reverses.

structural_cues: 76:3 ends with shakiran versus kafuran, and 76:5 ends with kafuran after only the punishment verse intervenes.
76:22 later describes the recipients' striving as mashkura.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same mapped root, the gratitude polarity, and aromatic versus ingratitude branches; I infer deliberate rhetorical conversion, while accidental homonymy with no activated semantic exchange remains materially possible.

changed_reading.before: Kafur is only the beverage's pleasant aromatic name.
changed_reading.after: Kafur also carries a contained root-reversal: what named covered favor is transformed into the fragrance of a favor fully acknowledged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus vessel opens immediately into a flowing source from which the servants drink and which they make gush abundantly; the cup is therefore the served endpoint of a distributable water system, not a sealed luxury object.

activation_trace.role: The cup with its contents supplies the bounded vessel that the next ayah opens toward a source.
An allotted water-share makes distribution, not mere sipping, available in the focus verb.
A spring of running water supplies the unbounded source behind the cup.
The repeated drinking root carries the focus allocation directly into the spring scene.
Wide splitting and outflow makes the recipients active releasers of abundance.

structural_cues: 76:6 follows without a break, begins with the accusative aynan, repeats drinking, and intensifies the final verb with a cognate verbal noun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate adjacency, a running spring, repeated drinking, and caused gushing; I infer vessel-to-source continuity and participatory distribution, while aynan could alternatively introduce a related but separate drink scene.

changed_reading.before: The righteous consume a finite cup prepared for them.
changed_reading.after: Their cup participates in a spring they can release into abundant flow, turning reception into empowered distribution.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who send nourishment outward while refusing repayment or thanks later receive repayment, thanks, and drink served by their Lord; the focus cup becomes returned hospitality without reducing the earlier gift to a bargain.

activation_trace.role: Dutiful kindness anchors al-abrar in enacted social care.
The allotted drink supplies the incoming counterpart to food sent outward.
Refusal to seek acknowledgment marks the earlier feeding as non-extractive.
Feeding another supplies the outward material transfer that defines the recipients.
The repayment they decline from beneficiaries establishes the absence of a human exchange claim.
Divine recompense answers the action from a different source and on a later horizon.
Giving drink reverses their role from providers of nourishment to honored recipients.
Their striving is finally acknowledged even though they demanded no thanks from those they fed.

structural_cues: 76:8-9 moves food outward with no requested recompense or thanks; 76:12, 76:21, and 76:22 return recompense, drink, and acknowledgment.
The focus cup appears before the deeds are narrated, so the later lines retrospectively identify what al-abrar means in practice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outgoing food, disclaimed human return, later divine return, and served drink; I infer a non-transactional counter-hospitality, while a simpler reward-for-deeds sequence remains a live account.

changed_reading.before: A morally named class receives an unexplained luxury drink.
changed_reading.after: The drink is returned hospitality: people who nourished vulnerable others without extracting return are themselves abundantly served and acknowledged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact cup-was-mixed construction returns with ginger and is again followed by a named spring; this makes the camphor cup the first member of a deliberately paired, spring-linked beverage architecture.

activation_trace.role: The content-bearing cup anchors the first half of the repeated construction.
Mixing supplies the compositional relation duplicated in the later cup.
Aromatic kafur distinguishes the first draught from its ginger counterpart.
The repeated temporal predicate helps establish clause-level parallelism.
The second running spring confirms the cup-to-source pattern created after the focus.
Being given drink explicitly frames the second draught as service to the same recipients.
The same content-bearing cup repeats the focus vessel.
The repeated mixture relation makes ginger and camphor contrast within one designed system.

structural_cues: 76:5 and 76:17 share ka'san kana mizajuha with only the named constituent changed.
Each construction is followed by aynan in 76:6 and 76:18.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact syntactic repetition and two following springs; I infer a paired beverage design and source linkage, while the accusative springs could be parallel amenities rather than strict appositives to the mixtures.

changed_reading.before: The camphor cup is a standalone emblem of refreshment.
changed_reading.after: It is the first of two coordinated spring-draughts, defined relationally by its camphor pole against a later ginger pole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The setting excludes both solar heat and severe cold, its vessels are exactly proportioned, and its culminating drink purifies others; with mizaj as bodily temperament, camphor becomes one element in calibrated balance rather than a simple maximum-cold flavor.

activation_trace.role: Bodily temperament makes balanced constitution available within the focus mixture.
Aromatic camphor supplies a cooling and fragrant material pole without exhausting the mixture's function.
The absent sun removes the hot extreme from the recipients' environment.
The absent severe cold prevents camphor from collapsing into mere refrigeration.
Fitting a thing to its measure and a middle bound supplies the calibration principle.
A drink that purifies another extends beverage composition from sensation to transformative effect.

structural_cues: 76:13 negates both thermal extremes, 76:16 stresses exact measure, and 76:21 culminates in a purifying drink.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two excluded extremes, measured vessels, purification, and the temperament branch of mizaj; I infer a balanced constitutional effect, while the climate, vessel sizing, and drinks may remain separate features.

changed_reading.after: Camphor belongs to a precisely tempered, non-extreme and potentially purifying composition fitted to the whole person.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protection from the day's evil expands into a tree-covered garden and lowered shade; the covering branch latent in kafur lets the aromatic admixture participate microscopically in the same sheltering logic.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment supplies a latent protective material image inside kafur.
The aromatic branch keeps the reading attached to the actual named admixture.
Repelling harm through protection supplies the transition from threat to safety.
A garden concealed by trees scales covering up into an inhabited environment.
Shade as covering makes shelter physically close over the recipients.

structural_cues: 76:11-14 moves continuously from warded evil to garden, absence of harsh exposure, and near shade.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, tree-cover, shade, and a covering branch under the focus root; I infer that the admixture echoes shelter at beverage scale, while the safer alternative treats kafur as fragrance with no protective function.

changed_reading.before: The aromatic ingredient only modifies taste and scent.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its covering resonance miniaturizes the surah's larger shelter: safety is mixed into what the righteous take inside.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because al-abrar is grammatically a human group and the grain, ripening, and fruit-cover branches are form-distant; it remains anchored in three focus roots and gains a cultivation sequence from feeding and lowered fruit, but downstream prose should present it only as an imagistic harvest overlay, never as the lexical gloss of al-abrar or kafur.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Birr has a grain branch, mizaj has a grain-color ripening branch, and k-f-r has a fruit-cover branch within the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Grain and wheat place a cultivated kernel-image beneath the human title al-abrar.
Grain changing from green toward yellow supplies maturation within the focus mixture.
A fruit sheath supplies protective covering around developing produce.
The seed that sprouts and bears grain activates a growth cycle behind the human act of love.
Fruit reaching maturity links cultivation to the food the righteous give away.
Near, picked fruit completes the seed-to-harvest image in the reward scene.

changed_reading.before: The ayah contains only human recipients and a finished beverage.
changed_reading.after: As a contained overlay, the righteous appear as a ripened moral harvest: seed, maturation, protective covering, outgoing food, and accessible fruit converge around their cup.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus plainly depicts a beverage and the revelation unit begins much later; it remains anchored in attested sh-r-b branches of permeation and understanding plus context branches of delivery, gathering, and reminder, but downstream prose should qualify it as a cross-domain analogy for embodied reception rather than identify the cup with the Quran.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yashrabun carries branches of permeation into the heart and drinking-as-understanding while ka's keeps the image materially liquid.

activation_trace.role: Permeating color or heart turns drinking into inward saturation.
Drinking as understanding supplies the explicit cognitive bridge.
The cup and contents retain the physical anchor that contains the analogy.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the cognitive effect received inwardly.
Sending something down and delivering it supplies movement from giver to recipient.
Gathering and collection parallels a composed content made receivable as a whole.

changed_reading.before: Drinking is only sensory consumption of reward.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified analogy, drinking models reception that enters, permeates, and becomes understanding, anticipating the later delivered reminder without ceasing to be a literal drink.

strongest_changes: The cup opens immediately into a spring the recipients themselves make gush, changing finite consumption into participatory abundance.
The exact camphor-cup construction is paired with the later ginger-cup construction, each followed by a spring.
The selfless transfer of food is answered by returned drink, recompense, and acknowledgment, retrospectively defining al-abrar.
The earlier mixed human drop makes the later mizaj available as restorative recomposition, not flavor alone.
The sequence kafuran to kafuran activates a contained reversal from covering a favor to aromatic, acknowledged favor.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package exposed two unusually strong latent structures at once: exact cup-mixture parallelism across 76:5-6 and 76:17-18, and a root-level shukr/k-f-r economy that converts the focus aroma into more than decorative flavor.
remaining_uncertainties: The k-f-r reversal may be deliberate root-play or only an activated homonymic resonance.
The springs after the two cups may be strict appositional sources or adjacent, related amenities.
The constitutional reading of mizaj may indicate transformation of the person or remain a culinary metaphor.
The shelter, harvest, and embodied-reception readings require explicit exploratory qualification because their branch transfers are cross-domain.
